name: M365Gov-NativeAlert-RiskyIdentity
displayName: M365 Governance - Native Alert and Risky Identity Correlation

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Microsoft Entra ID Protection
authoritativeControlOwner.sentinelRole: Correlates an existing native risk alert with normalized AI activity; it does not calculate identity risk.

dependencies.name: Microsoft Entra ID Protection native alert signal

freshness.expected: Both inputs must be within their documented connector latency.

limitations: Matching requires a native alert CompromisedEntity equal to ASIM ActorUsername.
Different identity formats or missing entities prevent correlation.
AI activity or usage volume is never promoted to identity risk.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Keep disabled until both functions and a native Entra risk signal are validated; use data health to surface missing inputs.

incidentConfiguration.grouping: Group by RiskAlertId and ActorUsername for PT6H.

severityRationale: Medium adds cross-product context without overriding the native product severity.
falsePositiveGuidance: Confirm the native risk alert is active and both identity fields represent the same account. Remediate in Microsoft Entra.
testQuery: Run both dependencies over an approved test window and verify an existing Entra risk alert joins to test AI activity for the same normalized username.
